name: Analyze Accelerated Stability Of Pharmaceutical Formulations
description: Analyzes the stability of pharmaceutical formulations under accelerated storage conditions.
detailed_description: Analyzes the stability of pharmaceutical formulations under accelerated storage conditions.
when_to_use: When you need analyze accelerated stability of pharmaceutical formulations analysis

parameters.formulations: [Required] List of formulation dictionaries containing name, active ingredient, concentration, and excipients (List[dict])
parameters.storage_conditions: [Required] List of storage condition dictionaries containing temperature, humidity (optional), and description (List[dict])
parameters.time_points: [Required] List of time points in days to evaluate stability (List[int])
